rows.commentary: 0.3: Jai Moondra targets the channel, and Michael van Lingen quietly pats the ball down into the off-side toward cover point.
0.4: Jai Moondra searches for swing with a fuller length, forcing Michael van Lingen to angle his bat face down and block it back toward mid-on.
0.5: Jai Moondra angles a full delivery into Michael van Lingen, who nudges it away toward mid-on while hunting for early movement.
0.6: Jai Moondra induces a flashing edge from Michael van Lingen that races rapidly between the keeper and slip cordon for a fortunate boundary.
1.1: Byron McDonough strikes early as Louren Steenkamp flashes a half-hearted pull at a short ball down leg, feathering an edge through to wicketkeeper Lorcan Tucker.
1.2: Byron McDonough drifts a fuller delivery down leg past the swinging bat of Jan Frylinck, prompting the umpire to signal a wide.
1.2: Byron McDonough bowls a tight line, and Jan Frylinck simply dead-bats the ball down into the off-side turf.
1.3: Byron McDonough drops it short outside off, allowing Jan Frylinck to latch onto the pull and hammer it down to deep square for four.
1.4: Byron McDonough bangs it in, and Jan Frylinck mistimes an aerial pull that narrowly clears the fielder at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
1.5: Byron McDonough bowls a wide to Jan Frylinck.
1.5: Byron McDonough strays wide outside off, and Jan Frylinck ruthlessly drags the pull shot behind square to race away for four.
1.6: Byron McDonough delivers to Jan Frylinck, who steers the ball firmly behind square on the off-side to rotate the strike with a single.
2.1: No run for Jan Frylinck off Jai Moondra.
2.2: Jai Moondra pitches it on a length and extracts subtle movement away past Jan Frylinck's outside edge, eliciting a loud appeal that the umpire dismisses instantly.
2.3: Jai Moondra drops it on a length at the stumps, and Jan Frylinck steps squarely behind the line to dead-bat it back.
2.4: Jai Moondra angles a short-of-length delivery outside the off stump, nipping inward just enough for Jan Frylinck to watch it sail by.
2.5: Jan Frylinck does not score off Jai Moondra.
2.6: Jai Moondra targets the back of a length outside off, where Jan Frylinck calmly pats it down toward the point region.
15.3: Andy McBrine tosses it up, and Jan Frylinck push-drives it wide of the bowler's right hand to take a single.
15.4: Andy McBrine floats up a delivery, prompting Gerhard Erasmus to stride forward and play a defensive stroke.
15.5: Gerhard Erasmus goes for the drive, slices an edge that drops safely in front of the rushing deep cover fielder, and scampers back for two.
15.6: Andy McBrine attacks the stumps, allowing Gerhard Erasmus to nudge it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
16.1: Gavin Hoey drops it short, inviting Gerhard Erasmus to punch off the back foot down to deep cover for a single.
16.2: Gavin Hoey tosses one up on the sticks, catching an inside edge off Jan Frylinck's defensive push down to mid-wicket for one.
16.3: Gavin Hoey drags his length short, and Gerhard Erasmus pulls the ball away straight to mid-wicket.
16.4: Gavin Hoey fires in a skiddy, flatter delivery that beats Gerhard Erasmus's attempted paddle outside the line of impact.
16.5: Gavin Hoey extracts lovely loop and turn, leaving Gerhard Erasmus beaten entirely on the outside edge during a defensive prod.
16.6: Gavin Hoey darts a flatter one across, which Gerhard Erasmus stabs down into the off-side to rotate the strike.
17.1: Gerhard Erasmus drops back to read Andy McBrine's turn, neatly tucking it down to long-on for a single.
17.2: Andy McBrine tosses it up once more, and Jan Frylinck meets it solidly to defend it straight back down.
17.3: Andy McBrine draws Jan Frylinck forward on the defensive, zipping past the outside edge.
17.4: Andy McBrine floats this one up as Jan Frylinck dances down the track, clipping it straight to mid-on.
17.5: Andy McBrine tosses it outside off, inviting Jan Frylinck to stab it firmly down toward point.
17.6: Andy McBrine drops it short, allowing Jan Frylinck to hang back and slap it wide of cover for a brisk couple before long-off cleans it up.
18.1: Gavin Hoey drifts one into Gerhard Erasmus, who picks up a comfortable two runs out to deep backward point.
18.2: Gavin Hoey serves it up to Gerhard Erasmus, who launches it all the way down to long-on for a boundary.
30.4: Byron McDonough digs it in short on middle, Jan Frylinck leans forward for a heave, miscuing it straight to mid-wicket before an errant throw leaks an extra run.
30.5: Byron McDonough targets just outside off on a back of a length, and Gerhard Erasmus stays back to tap it towards backward point.
30.6: Byron McDonough fires it back of a length outside off, allowing Gerhard Erasmus to punch it past backward point for a brace before third man cuts it off.
31.1: Curtis Campher serves up a full delivery outside off, and Jan Frylinck steps forward to drive it wide of cover and mid-off, collecting two.
31.2: Curtis Campher digs it short on off, and Jan Frylinck rocks forward to absolutely pulverize a pull shot for a maximum that leaves deep square-leg stranded.
31.3: Curtis Campher lands a good length ball just outside off, prompting Jan Frylinck forward to punch it past cover for a single.
31.4: Curtis Campher pushes a full one just outside off, watching Gerhard Erasmus drive it right back before flashing a wry smile at a mock shy.
31.5: Curtis Campher maintains a tight good length just outside off, where Gerhard Erasmus presses forward to safely defend another dot.
31.6: Curtis Campher attacks the full length on middle, and Gerhard Erasmus responds with a pristine straight drive off the middle that races to the boundary.
32.1: Gavin Hoey tosses it full outside off, catching Jan Frylinck's thick inside edge into his pad for a looping deflection that falls safely with no short-leg in place.
32.2: Gavin Hoey loops it full on off, and Jan Frylinck drops to one knee to unleash a colossal slog-sweep sailing over deep mid-wicket for six.
32.3: Gavin Hoey drops onto a good length on middle and leg, letting Jan Frylinck step back and tuck it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
32.4: Hoey keeps it flat and on a good length outside off, allowing Erasmus to work it off the back foot with a thick outside edge past the diving McBrine at short third man for a brace.
32.5: Hoey darts another flat delivery into middle, met by a back-foot punch from Erasmus past a despairing left-handed dive at extra-cover before sweeper tidies up the single.
32.6: Hoey strikes as Frylinck's valiant 76-run knock spanning ninety deliveries, featuring six fours and two sixes, comes to an abrupt end via a catch taken by Jai Moondra.
33.1: Moondra is greeted by Erasmus with a prompt push out towards the sweeper-cover region for a single.
42.5: Gavin Hoey flights this full delivery on off, and Alexander Volschenk pushes forward with a straight bat to smother it.
42.6: Gavin Hoey targets a length on middle, where Alexander Volschenk sweeps it down to fine-leg for three as Moondra scrambles in vain.
43.1: Byron McDonough finds sharp nip-back into the pads, but the umpire rightly signals it sliding down leg past Alexander Volschenk.
43.2: Byron McDonough strays down leg with a short ball, allowing Alexander Volschenk to glide it expertly to the fine-leg boundary.
43.3: Byron McDonough pitches full outside off, catching the high part of Alexander Volschenk's bat as he pushes back harmlessly to the bowler.
43.4: Byron McDonough offers a full one outside off that Alexander Volschenk edges off the inner half, escaping mid-wicket's desperate dive before Tector cleans it up.
43.5: Byron McDonough gets a fullish delivery on middle past Gerhard Erasmus's shuffle, squeezing out a leg-bye as it heads down leg.
43.6: Byron McDonough hits a short of length on middle, and Alexander Volschenk steps back to nudge a brisk single in front of cover.
44.1: Curtis Campher delivers full outside off, inviting Alexander Volschenk forward to stroke it firmly towards cover.
44.2: Curtis Campher rolls out a slower delivery on a length outside off, pulled away by Alexander Volschenk towards deep square-leg for a single.
44.3: Curtis Campher lands it on a good length outside off, and Gerhard Erasmus opens his bat face to steer it down to third man.
44.4: Curtis Campher drops it short outside off, and Alexander Volschenk punches it violently past a helpless mid-off for four.
44.5: Curtis Campher floats a clever slower delivery on a fuller length outside off, drawing Alexander Volschenk forward into a drive that picks out cover precisely.
44.6: Alexander Volschenk taps a short-of-length slower ball to Campher's right and scampers through with Gerhard Erasmus, beating a desperate direct hit at the bowler's end.
45.1: Jai Moondra drops one full on middle stump, allowing Alexander Volschenk to stride forward and flick it wide of long-on where Tector mops up the single.
45.2: Gerhard Erasmus swivels back on a short delivery down leg, gloving it down to fine-leg to bring up his third ODI hundred with a raised bat and a broad smile.
45.3: Alexander Volschenk clears the boundary off Jai Moondra for six.
45.4: Jai Moondra serves it up again, and Alexander Volschenk pushes it away down towards long-on for a comfortable single.
